data.summary:
Senior Project Analyst | Business Transformation | Process Automation | Financial Services & Payments Leadership 
Senior financial services and payments professional with 20+ years of experience, including 15+ years with American Express, leading project delivery, digital transformation, process automation, operational excellence, and enterprise process-improvement initiatives. Currently driving 3 automation initiatives across Japan Consumer and Corporate Cards and U.S. Consumer Cards, partnering with Technology, Automation, Compliance, and Operations teams to translate business priorities into scalable process and automation solutions. Skilled in developing process flows, leading process walkthroughs, aligning stakeholders, securing approvals, and supporting implementation of productivity-enhancement initiatives. Recognized for delivering measurable operational impact, including a 25% efficiency improvement, a 50% reduction in manual workflow, and a 5 FTE reduction through process and technology-led transformation.
CAREER HIGHLIGHTS • • Global payments and financial-services experience • Automation and digital transformation experience • • Approximately 10–15 FTE operational capacity improvement expected from current automation initiatives • Current initiatives targeting up to 70% FTE reduction in selected processes • • • Experience supporting a product launch across 18 markets • Experience leading teams and coordinating cross-functional stakeholders
20+ years of professional experience • 15+ years with American Express
3 current automation initiatives across Japan and U.S. card businesses
50% manual-workflow reduction delivered through previous initiative 25% efficiency improvement delivered through previous initiative
